scope: Atlas lessons 1A-13B and full-book page-flow contact sheets 01-07.
method: Inspected every assigned atlas JPG with view_image at original detail. Inspected all seven book contact sheets, then opened the three suspected sparse book pages individually. Read atlas_layout.json to confirm lesson/page mapping. No lesson or renderer edits.

summary.status: Changes requested for connector clearance and sparse spill pages.

findings.description: Diagonal swimlane connectors pass through event-label text. In 5B the routes cross Receive refund with K-17 and Cancel future scheduling. In 11B the routes cross Save approved K-17: pending and Atomically commit RF-9 + key. Event order remains understandable, but text and arrow paths visually interfere.
findings.actionable_fix: Route swimlane connectors through lane/column gutters, or give each event label an opaque clearance box and clip connectors outside its bounds. Re-render and inspect both pages; apply the shared renderer fix to every swimlane.

findings.description: A full-page lab break isolates short prose tails on preceding pages. PDF 24 has one paragraph at the top and approximately 85% empty body area; PDF 54 has two short paragraphs and approximately 70% empty body area; PDF 190 has one paragraph and approximately 90% empty body area. The following labs are PDF 25, 55 and 191.
findings.actionable_fix: Rebalance the immediately preceding prose/diagram spacing or diagram height so the short tails fit on their preceding pages before inserting the full-page labs. Preserve prose and avoid shrinking text below the established readable size. If necessary, adjust the substantive anchor within the chapter rather than accepting an isolated paragraph page.

findings.description: The packet skill value handle_refund_request 2.3.0 wraps inside the identifier as handle_refund_reque / st 2.3.0. Nothing is clipped, but the mid-token break slows reading of the literal manifest value.
findings.actionable_fix: Give the packet value column enough width for the identifier, or use an explicitly shortened display label while retaining the exact package identity in the surrounding explanation. Prefer layout adjustment over reducing the font size.

clean_findings: The other 23 assigned atlas lesson pages have no actionable text clipping, shape overlap, incorrect arrow destination, or split-unit finding.
All assigned labs remain complete on one page, with prediction strip, takeaway, assumption and answer link intact.
Proportional bars, capacity tray, ledger balances and interval whiskers visually match their declared quantities; zero-value bars are visibly absent.

The seven book contact sheets show no fully blank accidental page or split visual lesson. Front-matter and part-opening whitespace is intentional; the three sparse prose spill pages are flagged separately.
limitations: Book contact sheets were reviewed for pagination and unit integrity, not full-size copyediting of every prose page. Only the three suspicious book spill pages were opened individually.
Findings describe the rendered files inspected during this review; any regenerated version needs a targeted recheck.
